objective: Repair the source-backed CPVS 781k parent and 730k light-curve derivation path and rerun the complete fail-closed Issue #63 validation.

failure_analysis.previous_root_cause: The published CPVS Table2 artifact exposes ZTF identifiers in its catalog rows rather than an explicit SourceID header; the generic parser therefore returned zero parent IDs.
failure_analysis.previous_failure: parent row/object count mismatch: expected 781602, got 0
failure_analysis.new_root_cause: The published Zenodo ztf2g.zip and ztf2r.zip archives each contain multiple members, while the derivation CLI supplied no member selector. The parser correctly failed closed instead of guessing a member.

changes: Retain the documented 1-based CPVS Table2 ordinal SourceID fallback.
For multi-member light-curve ZIP archives, deterministically select the unique member whose header contains SourceID plus the required band error column.
Fail closed if zero or multiple members match; explicit --g-member/--r-member remains available.
Add regression coverage for successful multi-member selection and ambiguous-member rejection.
repair.scientific_basis: Zenodo documents ztf2g as g-band single-exposure data with SourceID and e_gmag, and ztf2r as r-band single-exposure data with SourceID and e_rmag.

validation.blocker: Fresh source-backed Heavy execution must verify 781602 parent IDs, 730184 selected IDs, immutable derivation evidence, and a fail-closed scientific gate PASS. Issue #51 remains separately unresolved.

findings: The CPVS published Table2 artifact requires the documented 1-based ordinal SourceID fallback when no explicit SourceID header is present.
The published ztf2g and ztf2r archives require schema-based unique member selection when multiple ZIP members are present.
Ambiguous or schema-mismatched source artifacts must fail closed rather than guess.
The repair is not scientifically accepted until a fresh full Heavy execution produces immutable evidence.

open_blockers: Fresh source-backed Heavy rerun has not yet verified the repaired 781602/730184 derivation.
Issue #51 historical ALeRCE snapshot/live-data drift remains unresolved.

knowledge_carried_forward: Immutable scientific evidence required before acceptance
